must_find.item: None of the features is meaningfully associated with outcome.
must_find.quote: No numeric feature differs significantly between outcome classes. The largest raw difference, feat_5 (outcome=1 minus outcome=0: +0.091, Welch p=0.207), is not significant after multiplicity correction (BH p=0.579).
must_find.reason: The report states that no numeric feature is significantly associated with outcome, and that group is not significant either, so no feature is meaningfully associated.

must_find.item: Predictive models do not meaningfully beat the majority-class baseline.
must_find.quote: Neither model beats the majority-class baseline (accuracy 0.5875) on the 160-row test split: logistic regression reaches 0.550 and gradient boosting 0.531.
must_find.reason: The report states directly that neither model beats the majority baseline and that the features carry little out-of-sample signal.

must_not_claim.item: One of the features (feat_1 to feat_5, or group) significantly predicts or drives outcome, stated as a real effect.
must_not_claim.quote: No numeric feature differs significantly between outcome classes.
must_not_claim.reason: The report explicitly says no feature or group is significant and does not claim any real effect.

must_not_claim.item: A model predicts outcome well, or clearly better than the majority-class baseline.
must_not_claim.quote: Neither model beats the majority-class baseline (accuracy 0.5875) on the 160-row test split
must_not_claim.reason: The report says neither model beats the baseline and does not claim good prediction.
